notes.title: Celebrate Oktoberfest in Teleria and get Granyt Doorkeep!
notes.content:
Fuse a brand-new legendary champion from the dwarves faction, Granyt Doorkeep, to celebrate Oktoberfest in RAID!

Granyt is a defensive powerhouse who can remove all debuffs from himself while increasing his allies' accuracy and critical damage.

Enter RAID's Oktoberfest bash - don’t miss themed offers, festive rewards, and plenty of fun activities!

Good luck and happy Oktoberfest!

notes.title: Raid Digest (19.09.25)
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Raiders! The TMNT campaign is in full swing: Teleria’s woods echo with the clash of half shells and steel. Fearless Turtle Champions are rising, new team compositions are being put to the test, and Shredder fights to hold his ground in the shadowy depths of his Dungeon.
[/p][p]There’s always something brewing in RAID!
[/p][p] But now, enough chatter. The #RAIDDigest has arrived — jump in!
[/p][h2]Special Gift for Collecting All 6 TMNT Champions[/h2][p] The TMNT campaign runs until November 13, and there’s a special reward waiting for those who collect all 6 TMNT Champions before it ends![/p][p] If you manage to gather the full squad, whether through in-game activities or Shards, you’ll receive an exclusive Shredder Avatar, Xibia’s Servitude Relic, and a bundle of other in-game goodies. Once all 6 Champions are in your account, the gift will soon appear in the Shop as a free offer for you to claim. 
 [/p][h2]Kro’khad the Throatripper’s and Donatello Fragments[/h2][p]We noticed that some of you missed out on the Donatello Fragments Offer last time. Don’t worry, we’re giving you another chance![/p][p]Both Kro’khad the Throatripper and Donatello Fragment offers will make a comeback for players who already have 50 or more Fragments. These offers will be available in the Shop for seven days, from 16:30 UTC on September 19 to 16:30 UTC on September 26.[/p][p]Also, starting with the next major update in October, you'll be able to exchange Kro’khad and Donatello Fragments in the Portal.[/p][p][/p][h2]CvC, Personal Rewards, and a Visual Bug[/h2][p]Next week’s CvC Tournament is planned to include Personal Rewards![/p][p]A quick reminder about a visual bug related to the Clan Tournament, especially with the next CvC just around the corner. The bug visually depletes the “x2 bonus points limit,” but don’t worry, you’re still receiving all the bonus points for personal achievements in the marked activities, even if the limit indicator looks off. A fix will be included in the next big update.[/p][p]And last but not least, more contests are on the way! Big thanks to everyone who joined the TMNT Insignia Contest on Discord and the #TMNTSculptingChallenge on Facebook! Another contest is coming this September–October: a fun DIY challenge on Facebook with a chance to win a TMNT Leonardo Avatar and other goodies. Stay tuned for all the details closer to the launch of the new competition! 
[/p][p]That’s all for today’s #RAIDDigest! We’ll see you next time, Raiders![/p]

notes.title: Fuel Deck of Fate Event
notes.content:
Grab a slice and get back in the fight - the Fuel Deck of Fate Event is here!

Earn Pizza Slices through in-game activities and use them to flip Cards in the Fuel Deck of Fate. The rarer the Card, the better the reward.

Don't miss this unique opportunity to earn Radiant Sunlilies of different Rarities, as well as Pizza Points for the Smart Fella Titan Event and other valuable goodies. Use Radiant Sunlilies to craft powerful Relics in the Forge!

May fate be on your side!

notes.title: RAID Digest (05.09.25)
notes.content:
[p]Hello Raiders, and welcome to the new #RAIDdigest! While you all must be busy building turtle teams and eating pizza, we don’t want to take up much of your time, so we’ll be brief with today’s updates. Without further ado, let’s start![/p][p][/p][p][b]Basalt Balance Changes[/b][/p][p]With update 10.70, we have added more opportunities for players to obtain Basalt, namely in the following locations: [/p][list][*][p]Cursed City C20 - x1 Basalt 2*[/p][/*][*][p]Cursed City D15 - x1 Basalt 3*[/p][/*][*][p]Cursed City P16 - x1 Basalt 3*[/p][/*][*][p]Cursed City S4 - x1 Basalt 3*[/p][/*][*][p]Cursed City S9 - x1 Basalt 4*[/p][/*][*][p]Cursed City S22 - x1 Basalt 4*[/p][/*][*][p]LA Seasons Step 4 - x1 Basalt 2*[/p][/*][*][p]LA Seasons Step 11 - x1 Basalt 2*[/p][/*][*][p]LA Seasons Step 17 - x1 Basalt 3*[/p][/*][*][p]LA Seasons Step 29 - x1 Basalt 3*[/p][/*][*][p]LA Seasons Step 34 - x1 Basalt 4*[/p][/*][*][p]Chimera Trials (Normal Difficulty) - x1 Basalt 1*[/p][/*][*][p]Chimera Trials (Hard Difficulty) - x1 Basalt 1*[/p][/*][*][p]Chimera Trials (Brutal Difficulty) - x1 Basalt 2*[/p][/*][*][p]Chimera Trials (Nightmare Difficulty) - x1 Basalt 3*[/p][/*][*][p]Chimera Trials (Ultra-Nightmare Difficulty) - x1 Basalt 3*, x1 Basalt 4*[/p][/*][/list][p]Please note that while most of these changes are already in the game, the Live Arena Seasons Balance changes will come live with the start of the next season (October 7th).[b]

Miscellaneous[/b][/p][list][*][p]We would like to remind you that you can obtain Gleaming Fyrgems not only from the Platinum Forge Pass, but also from various in-game Events and Tournaments. [/p][/*][*][p]Since the 10.70 update, the red dot on Doom Tower secret rooms has remained until the room is cleared. We are aware of this bug and are already working on a fix, which is planned for the next big release.[/p][/*][*][p]Those of you who collected more than 50 Fragments during the Donatello fusion Event will have a chance to obtain more of those through the offer, which will appear in the game tomorrow. [/p][/*][*][p]Some of you have been asking for the opportunity to exchange Kro’khad the Throatripper’s fragments in the Portal. For technical reasons, you’ll be able to exchange fragments of this Champion starting with the next big release, along with Donatello’s fragments. [/p][/*][*][p]Leonardo, Raphael, April, and Donatello are available from Shards until 13 November, unlike Michelangelo, who сannot be summoned from Shards and is not in the pool. [/p][/*][/list][p]As for Shredder - he is also not part of the usual summon pool, however, you can summon him during special boosted events, also only until 13 November.[/p][p][/p][p][b]CvC and personal rewards[/b][/p][p]The next installment of the Clan Tournament will not offer personal rewards; however, do not let that stop you from pursuing victory!

Also, please keep in mind that the bug that depletes "x2 bonus points limits" still exists. We wanted to remind you that this is only a visual bug and you can earn all the bonus points with personal achievements on marked activities, regardless of the limit indicator. We’re already working on a fix and will add it to one of the next big releases. [/p][p][/p][p]That’s all we have for you today. Have a fabulous weekend, and we'll see you in two weeks![/p]

notes.title: Smart Fella Titan Event
notes.content:
Help Donatello understand more about Teleria in the Smart Fella Titan Event!

Get your hands on pizza points by taking part in a variety of clearly-marked events and tournaments. Use those points to progress and earn milestone rewards, including Donatello's perfect soul that will unlock his true potential, as well as new relics with unique abilities.

notes.title: New Platinum Forge Pass in Season 29!
notes.content:
Conquer the Forge Pass and craft exclusive relics with gleaming fyrgems from the new Platinum Forge Pass!

Complete challenges to earn points and increase your forge pass level. Claim valuable rewards, including gleaming fyrgems from the brand-new Platinum Forge Pass and craft exclusive new relics to crush your enemies in the blink of an eye. You can get more awesome goodies depending on the type of Forge Pass you have - core, gold, or platinum.

Happy raiding!

notes.title: RAID Digest 22.08.25
notes.content: [p]Cowabunga raiders! While we tried to keep them in the shadows, apparently trench coats and hats are not that much of a disguise…  we can all agree that it was Mikey’s fault.[/p][p]Regardless, the heroes are out of the sewers, and Shredder is out there plotting for his no doubt diabolical goals, and we are going straight into the Digest.[/p][p][/p][h2]In-game chat mute[/h2][p]Yes, by popular demand, we are happy to announce that after the next big update, players will be able to mute other chatters in the in-game chat. If you decide to mute someone, you will still be able to see them posting a message, but the message itself will be hidden. Which means that if you need some screenshots to report some misconduct, you can freely unmute, take screenshots, and mute that again. [/p][p]We hope that this change will help our players create and maintain a better chatting environment. [/p][p]Please keep in mind that muted chatters are muted only for your message feed.[/p][p][/p][h2]Siege bugs[/h2][list][*][p]After upgrading the Stronghold to level 4, some posts with the same condition appear twice. It is a bug, and we are working on a fix.[/p][/*][*][p]Siege matchmaking for the 7th and 8th Tiers does not account for these tiers. This is also a bug, and it will be resolved shortly. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]New Relics[/h2][p]We had some questions about the new relics introduced to the game alongside the RAID x TMNT event. [/p][list][*][p]These relics will remain craftable for all players after the event ends.[/p][/*][*][p]Stars of the Jiinang will only work with Turn Meter fill effects, not the natural Turn Meter gain.[/p][/*][*][p]If a hero with Deathdealer hits a hero with Xibia's Servitude, Xibia's hit type change will be triggered first.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Free Gear Removal[/h2][p]This is a small reminder, just in case you missed it: Since yesterday and moving forward, the Gear removal is free. Find a better use for all that Silver![/p][p][/p][h2]Clan vs. Clan Tournament and Personal Rewards[/h2][p]The Next Clan vs. Clan Tournament will feature Personal Rewards. Cowabunga it is![/p][p][/p][p]That is all for today, and if you have a sudden urge to order pizza, please know, you are not alone 🍕[/p]

notes.title: Summon the genius Turtle, Donatello, via Champion Fragments!
notes.content:
Get ready to summon a turtle-y awesome, legendary champion from the lizardmen - Donatello!

A certified genius, Donatello is all about supporting his allies by decreasing their skill cooldowns and keeping them healthy. Donnie wants nothing more than to reunite with April and his brothers, and get everyone back home safe.

Head to the portal in-game to find out how to obtain all the champion fragments needed to add this radical warrior to your collection.

Good luck and happy raiding dudes!

notes.title: RAID x TMNT
notes.content:
The TMNT have fallen through a portal and into Teleria!

Log in on 7 different days to get the totally tubular Michelangelo. Stop the evil Shredder in the Event Dungeon, and recruit him via special summoning events. Fuse the brains of the team, Donatello, in a Fusion Event, and summon Leonardo, Raphael, & April O'Neil from shards and limited-time events throughout!

Don't miss out on these dimensional warriors - cowabunga!

notes.title: Michelangelo Chase
notes.content:
It's an awesome time to add a legendary champion, Michelangelo, to your collection!

Play RAID for 7 days to earn this rad ninja, and get his perfect soul after 14 days! Michelangelo is a powerful attack-type champion who works best alongside his turtle-y awesome brothers. With a variety of debuffs and an ability to evade enemies while trash-talking them, he's a valuable addition to any team!

Start the Michelangelo Chase before October 30 to ensure you get him - don't miss out!

notes.title: Take down the evil Shredder in the Event Dungeon!
notes.content:
As part of RAID x TMNT, we're bringing back the Event Dungeon with a truly terrifying boss - the dimensional tyrant himself, Shredder!

The Event Dungeon will open during specific, large-scale events and contain amazing rewards like powerful artifact sets. Among the rewards this time is the new and exclusive 9-piece Chronophage gear set that grants a new buff.

Check out this limited-time chance to get your hands on awesome rewards and test your might against an evil foe!

notes.title: Orc's Path Event
notes.content:
Seize the opportunity to get Packmaster Shy'ek and a perfect soul for Kro’khad the Throatripper in an Orc's Path Event!

Summon champions and get gear to earn hunting coins, then use them to unlock rewards along branching reward paths. This pair of feral champions are a powerhouse combination, hunting down foes with ruthless efficiency.

Have fun and happy raiding!

notes.title: Summer Nights Gift
notes.content:
There's so much going on in Teleria - you are definitely not going to want to miss out on everything that's happening. 

Come join in various events and tournaments that we've prepared to help celebrate the last days of summer. Grab a gift full of energy, multi-battle attempts, silver, and more.

Enjoy raiding in the coolness of summer evenings - jump in now!

notes.title: Adventure Deck of Fate Event
notes.content:
Earn fate fossils and flip cards to get gear from the pinpoint set as well as other goodies!

True to its name, pinpoint gear boosts a champion's ACC and SPD, while also giving them up to 4 intercept stacks when equipped with all 9 pieces.

You can earn fate fossils by getting artifacts and accessories as well as upgrading champions. The rarer the card you flip using them, the better the reward will be.

Don't miss out!

notes.title: RAID Digest (08.08.25)
notes.content:
[p]Hey, Raiders! As the Fragment Summon event for Kro'khad the Throatripper is gradually coming to its ending phase, we would like to remind you that soon there will be an in-game activity which will allow you to get Packmaster Shy'ek and a Soul for his pet Kro'khad. In the meantime, we invite you to the first Digest of the last month of this summer, where we comment on some of the most often discussed topics in the community over the past two weeks. 
[/p][p]Without further ado, let's get started. 
[/p][h2]9 Hydra Quick Battles[/h2][p]Starting from the update 10.60, all players have 9 instead of 5 attempts at a Hydra Quick Battle. However, for some Clans, the Hydra reset occurred before the update went live, so these Clans stepped into the new brave world of 10.60 version only with 5 Quick Battles. To compensate for that, yesterday we sent all players 4 additional Quick Battles attempts, regardless of the number of Quick Battles they had at the moment of the game update. Please note, though, that the total number of Quick Battle attempts cannot exceed 9, regardless of whether a player used any Quick Battles before we added 4 more attempts yesterday.
[/p][h2]Super Raids for Minotaur's Labyrinth[/h2][p]Since Super Raids for Mino were a popular request, we've activated them as a special time-limited event, just the way Super Raids functioned for other Dungeons for some time before we made their availability permanent. For the time being, Minotaur Super Raids are going to function like this, so we can make sure everything works properly first.[/p][h2]
Bugs and Fixes[/h2][p]Users of iOS devices have reported being unable to listen to music apps (like Spotify, iTunes, etc.) while playing RAID: Shadow Legends. This bug is being fixed and we are planning to deliver the fix in the next update.
[/p][p]A little while ago some players encountered a very nasty bug that prevented them from accessing the game UI: a click, tap or any other action led to no response from the application. Fortunately, the bug has been fixed in the update 10.60, so if you encountered it previously, please update your app and your experience with it should be smooth again.
[/p][h2]Clan vs. Clan Tournament and Personal Rewards[/h2][p]The next CvC Tournament won't feature Personal Rewards.
[/p][p]That wraps it up — thanks for reading, and catch you in two weeks![/p]

notes.title: New Update: Version 10.60.0
notes.content:
[p]Shadow Arena, Minotaur Super Raids, quality of life updates, and more!
 [/p][p]Update 10.60.0 is here, bringing with it a bunch of updates to various game modes. We’re introducing a Shadow Arena mode for Platinum Tier, Super Raids for the Minotaur’s Labyrinth, and a whole lot more quality of life updates that we hope will make your RAID experience that much better. Check out everything that’s coming below. [/p][h2]
Shadow Arena[/h2][p]To offer a more diverse and competitive experience in Platinum Tier Classic Arena, we're introducing a new feature – Shadow Arena – inspired by community feedback and aimed at creating a more exciting competition. This limited-time mode will hide all information about opponents until the Classic Arena weekly reset, meaning players will not be able to see who they are fighting against and team up with Clan allies.[/p][p][/p][h2]Minotaur Super Raids & Quality of Life Updates[/h2][p]We’re introducing time-limited Super Raids to the Minotaur’s Labyrinth, and an indication that shows which Champions have already earned the maximum number of Scrolls they need to unlock all of their Masteries. With this “MAX” indication, it’ll be clearer for players to know who they should switch or remove from the team.[/p][p]We’re also making sure that if you’re running Background Multi-Battles or Auto-Battle in the Minotaur’s Labyrinth and all Champions in the current team have reached the max number of scrolls, the current sequence of battles will end automatically to prevent players wasting unnecessary Energy.[/p][p][/p][h2]Selling Equipped Gear[/h2][p]When managing your Gear, we’re replacing the option to destroy equipped Gear with the ability to sell or remove it instead. You’ll now be able to sell equipped Gear directly from a Champion’s loadout, or through the Gear Filter menu.[/p][p][/p][h2]Doom Tower Quality of Life[/h2][p]We’ve introduced some quality of life updates to the Doom Tower, meaning Presets can be saved across different Rotations of the Doom Tower.[/p][p][/p][h2]Clan vs Clan Points Update[/h2][p]The CvC Points multiplier will now no longer appear once you’ve reached the Points cap for that Objective type. Also, we’re adding multiplier labels to the Game Modes menu to highlight areas of the game where you can earn extra points in the active CvC Tournament. This feature will be made available in-game with the next CvC launch.[/p][p][/p][h2]Clan Shop Items Distribution[/h2][p]We’ve redistributed some of the resources you can earn from the Clan Shop, such as making Gilded Medallions available to Clans at earlier Clan Levels.[/p][p][/p][h2]Champion Filter in the Sparring Pit[/h2][p]Champions that have already reached Max Level will no longer appear when selecting a Champion for the Sparring Pit.[/p][p][/p][h2]Guardian Ring Quality of Life[/h2][p]We’ve introduced a quality of life update for the Guardian Ring which prevents the game from resetting the list of Champions when you’ve previously scrolled down and unselected a Champion.[/p][p][/p][h2]Champion Filter Stat Range Quality of Life[/h2][p]We’re introducing stat ranges when filtering Champions. Now, you’ll be able to sort through your Champion Collection to find Champions with specific amounts of certain stats like Speed or Critical Rate.[/p][p][/p][h2]Gear Filter Improvement[/h2][p]We’ve improved the Gear Filter, so now you can filter Gear by the number of Substat upgrades. For that, simply choose a Substat in the Filter Menu and select an option.[/p][p][/p][h2]Enable Notifications[/h2][p]We’ve improved the ability to receive notifications from the game by adding more clear information regarding notifications in the Profile window.[/p][p][/p][h2]Siege Mana Shrines Improvements[/h2][p]We’ve made a tooltip in the Siege Battle Phase that shows how many Rebattle attempts are available in Mana Shrines. Also, we’ve added a notification when Rebattle attempts are available, along with a reminder to set Building Bonuses.[/p][p][/p][h2]Advanced Quests Rebalance[/h2][p]Old versions:[/p][p]Clear Stage 15 or higher of the Sand Devil's Necropolis 5 times[/p][p]Win 3 Live Arena battlеs[/p][p]Clear Stage 15 or higher of the Phantom Shogun's Grove 5 times[/p][p]New versions:[/p][p]Clear Stage 15 or higher of the Sand Devil's Necropolis 3 times[/p][p]Win 1 Live Arena battlе[/p][p]Clear Stage 15 or higher of the Phantom Shogun's Grove 3 times[/p][p][/p][h2]Champion Rebalance[/h2][h3]Khoronar[/h3][p]\[Skill 1 – Flourish of Slaughter][/p][p]Old Version:[/p][p]Attacks all enemies. Has a 50% chance of decreasing each target's Turn Meter by 5%.[/p][p]Attacks all enemies 2 times instead of 1 and the chance of decreasing each target's Turn Meter increases to 100% if Minaya is on the same team. The damage of each hit will be decreased by 50%.[/p][p]New version: [/p][p]Attacks all enemies. Has a 50% chance of decreasing each target's Turn Meter by 10%.[/p][p]If Minaya is on the same team, attacks all enemies 2 times and the chance to decrease each target's Turn Meter becomes 100% instead. The damage of each hit will be decreased by 50%.[/p][p]- Damage multiplier increased.[/p][p]\[Ascended Skill 2 – Beastly Bellow][/p][p]Old Version:[/p][p]Has a 75% chance of placing a \[Provoke] debuff on all enemies for 1 turn. Places a \[Block Debuffs] buff and a 60% \[Increase DEF] buff on this Champion for 2 turns.[/p][p]Removes all debuffs from this Champion before placing the \[Block Debuffs] and \[Increase DEF] buffs if Minaya is on the team.[/p][p]New version: [/p][p]Has a 75% chance of placing a \[Provoke] debuff on all enemies for 1 turn. notes.title: Kro'khad Fragment Event
notes.content:
It's time for a fragment event to help you get your hands on a legendary beast - introducing the Kro'khad Fragment Event!

This ferocious creature roams the dunes of the kro'khan desert as the ultimate apex predator, ripping and shredding its prey asunder.

notes.title: RAID Digest (25.07.2025)
notes.content:
[p]Hey Raiders! Summer is in full swing, and it is a perfect time for sunbathing, swimming, or just enjoying ice cream. Shout-out to our Southern Hemisphere players! Enjoy the winter vibes! Stay warm out there! ❄️🔥 The long-awaited doggo Kro'khad the Throatripper is getting ready to join Teleria and, as per our tradition, we've prepared several updates for you. Without further ado, let's dive into our next issue of RAID Digest:[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Kro'khad the Throatripper and Packmaster Shy'ek[/b][/h2][p]As you most likely know, Kro'khad the Throatripper will join the game soon. When it happens, Packmaster Shy'ek's skills description will include his new companion. [/p][p][/p][p]By the way, in August you’ll have an opportunity to fuse not only the doggo, but also get his master (for those who missed the Packmaster Shy'ek’s fusion) and also the Kro’khad the Throatripper's Soul from another activity to receive the most out of this pair! wink-wink[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Rebalance of the Crown of Corruption Relic[/b][/h2][p]Following a review of recent usage data and players’ feedback, we've determined that the Crown of Corruption Relic provides an excessive Speed boost, making it too overpowered in the current state of the game. To improve game balance and player experience, especially when facing opponents equipped with the Crown of Corruption Relic, it will be rebalanced and aligned with other Relics of the same Rarity regarding the Speed increase in the next update 10.60.[/p][p]
Below, you can see how the rebalanced New Crown of Corruption Relic will look like after the nearest release:

SPD - 24[/p][p]C.DMG - 21%[/p][p]HP - 1662[/p][p]While you have more than 50% HP, you deal + 5% (7.5/10/12.5/17.5/25) more damage and [b]receive 5% (7/9/11/13/15) less damage[/b]. While you have less than 50% HP, you deal 25% less damage and receive [b]15% more damage[/b]. 
[/p][p]Owners of the rebalanced Crown of Corruption Relic will receive 640 Starstones in a couple of days after the update so that they are able to unequip the Relic from the Champion right away, if they want to, of course.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Stormcaller Relic: \[Stormcall] Buff Fix[/b][/h2][p]We've noticed incorrect behavior of \[Stormcall] buff from Stormcaller Relic that places \[Stun] on enemies. Now \[Stun] from \[Stormcall] buff cannot be resisted and does not trigger Polymorph. That is not the way it should work, as it damages the overall game balance. We will fix it in the nearest release. After update 10.60 we expect \[Stun] placed by \[Stormcall] buff to work like a regular \[Stun] debuff, that means it can be reflected by Wand of Submission Relic/Deflection Set, can't be applied due to Hand of Uncreation Relic effect, and can trigger Polymorph.
[/p][h2][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/h2][p][b]Live Arena Seasons Points Not Resetting. [/b]There is a visual bug with LA Seasonal points "not resetting" that may occasionally occur at the beginning of the new Season. It's a visual bug, it doesn't affect points calculations on the server side. The fix is already in the works and should be included in the 10.70 release.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Gemstones in Milestones of Hard Faction Wars instead of the Chest. [/b]Gemstones should not be displayed in Milestones of Hard Faction Wars. This UI bug is going to be addressed in the nearest big update.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Clan League Challenges.[/b] Winning a Siege in Tiers 7 and 8 will be added to the Clan League Challenges. We plan to add these Challenges to the Clan League in the release 10.70. Points will be added retroactively.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Clan vs Clan Tournament and Personal Rewards[/b][/h2][p]Sharpen your swords, the next installment of Clan vs Clan Tournament will feature Personal Rewards. May the strongest Clan win![/p][p][/p][p]That’s all for today's Digest. See you soon![/p]

notes.title: RAID Digest (11.07.25)
notes.content:
[p]Hey, Raiders! While the echoes of the latest release are gradually fading, we’ve prepared a few clarifications and updates to share with you today. And where better to drop them than right here, in our RAID Digest?[/p][p]Let’s dive in! [/p][p][b]All You Need to Know About the Recent Changes to Chimera[/b][/p][p]And you need to know a lot[b] 😉[/b][/p][p]With the latest update, we[b] decreased the damage requirement[/b] for some Chimera Trials! Below, you’ll find some details on each Chimera Form. 

🐏[b]Ram Form[/b][/p][list][*][p]Damage the Chimera while it is under a \[Fear] or \[True Fear] debuff. Only counts damage from skills. [i](DMG requirement decreased on Nightmare and Ultranightmare Boss Difficulties).[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Damage the Chimera within 3 of its turns while it is under a \[Decrease DEF] debuff and your Champions are under \[Perfect Veil] buffs. [i](DMG requirement decreased on Brutal, Nightmare, and Ultranightmare Boss Difficulties).[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Damage the Chimera while it is under a \[Weaken] debuff and your Champions are under \[Increase C. RATE] or \[Increase C. DMG] buffs. Only counts damage from skills. [i](DMG requirement decreased on ALL Difficulties, except for Easy).[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Deplete the Chimera's Duel bar within 5 turns. [i](DMG requirement decreased on ALL Difficulties). [/i][/p][/*][/list][p]On top of it,[b] we decreased the number of \[Stun] debuffs [/b]required for the following Trial[b] [/b]on[b] ALL difficulties:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Block \[Stun] debuffs using \[Block Debuffs], \[Intercept], or \[Stone Skin] buffs within 5 of the Chimera's turns. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]🦁Lion Form[/b][/p][list][*][p]Absorb damage using \[Shield] buffs. Will not count surplus damage. [i](DMG requirement decreased on ALL Difficulties). [/i][/p][/*][*][p]Block damage using \[Block Damage] or \[Unkillable] buffs. [i](DMG requirement decreased on ALL Difficulties). [/i][/p][/*][*][p]Damage the Chimera using \[Reflect Damage] buffs, \[Pain Link] debuffs, or passive Reflect Damage effects. [i](DMG requirement decreased on ALL Difficulties). [/i][/p][/*][*][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]🐍Viper Form[/b][/p][list][*][p]Damage the Chimera with \[Poison] debuffs while it is also under a \[Poison Sensitivity] debuff. [i](DMG requirement decreased on ALL Difficulties). [/i][/p][/*][/list][p]Let’s move to the next topic in the Chimera section! [/p][p]With the latest release, we fixed a bug related to how one of the Lion Trials was counted. However, due to an oversight, this fix was not included in the Release Notes. [/p][p][b]The Lion Trial — “Place 6/8/10 debuffs on the Chimera within 5/4/3/2 of its turns. One of the debuffs must be a \[Decrease RES] debuff.”[/b] — had been functioning incorrectly since Chimera was first released. Previously, if the \[Decrease RES] debuff was applied after the previous challenge was completed, this trial would auto-complete, even if the full conditions had not been met. It now works in line with the description: you must have 6/8/10 active debuffs on the Chimera at the same time, and one of them must be \[Decrease RES]. The debuffs do not need to be unique — any type counts — but all 6/8/10 must be active simultaneously, including \[Decrease RES].[/p][p]Last but not least, to wrap up the Chimera section of our Digest, here’s a tip from the devs on how to deal with the Ram Chimera’s passive, [b]Unbreakable Focus[/b]. There’s a Rare Blessing called [b]Nature’s Bounty[/b] that converts \[Fear] into \[True Fear], which may offer a little help against Ram. 
[/p][p][b]Bugs and Fixes [/b][/p][list][*][p]Team Presets Issue. You may receive an error while setting or editing a Team Preset in the game. It's a known issue, and our developers are working on a fix.[/p][/*][*][p]Some Mythical Champions, which you encounter as opponents in the Hard Faction Wars, lose their HP bars when transforming into another form. It is a visual bug, which we’ll fix in the next big release. [/p][/*][*][p]Bug on Hard Faction Wars. An error message occurs during the battle when trying to complete the quest "Reduce XXXX enemies’ HP by 50% with one skill" with a multi-hit attack. We’ve already released the hotfix version 10.55.3. Make sure you have installed the latest game version to get rid of the nasty bug. [/p][/*][*][p]Sometimes, during Tag Team Arena battles, Skills are not working, or the skill button does not activate. This will be fixed in the next big release. Meanwhile, to avoid this, please do not press the Auto button when switching between battles in the Tag Team Arena. It is better to do this during the final damage animation before the team's victory or defeat. Also, you can click the Auto button a couple of times, and the battle state should recover and continue validly.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]Advanced Quests System Updates: A Few More Clarifications[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Advanced Quest “Use 1 Hydra key” cannot be swapped with “Use 1 Chimera key” because these quests come from different quest pools, so no surprises there! [/p][/*][*][p]“Use 6 Fortress Keys”  is a tricky quest.  It may appear even after you’ve already used your keys, unlike Hydra or Chimera Quests. To avoid missing out, please make sure to check/refresh your Advanced Quests before entering the Iron Twins Dungeon.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🏆Clan vs Clan Tournament and Personal Rewards[/b][/p][p]The next week's CvC Tournament is planned to be without Personal Rewards.[/p][p]That's all for today's RAID Digest. Until the next time, Raiders![/p]

notes.title: New Update: Version 10.55.0
notes.content:
[p]Update 10.55.0 is here, bringing an expansion and new feature to Siege, as well as improvements to Clan Quests, Faction Guardians, the Tavern, and more. There are also some significant changes coming to the Chimera. Check out everything that’s coming below.
[/p][h2]Siege Expansion[/h2][p]As part of the expansion coming to Siege, we’re introducing Tiers 7 and 8. There are new conditions to get into these new Tiers, as well as awesome rewards like Avatar Frames. We’re also introducing more Levels, Groups, and Team Slots for each Building, and we’ve reviewed the balance of Florins required to repair and upgrade Buildings. You’ll receive more Mana Orbs for protecting your Stronghold and Mana Shrines, destroying your enemy’s Stronghold, and rebattling previously-defeated Defense Teams in Mana Shrines. Lastly, we’re making it so that Clan Leaders can now remove a Clan member’s Defense Team from a Slot.
[/p][h2]Siege Traps[/h2][p]The second major addition to Siege is Traps. Players now can add Traps to their Defense Teams during the Prep Phase. Traps provide a variety of unique effects, such as hiding one of the defending Champions or denying enemy healing. Placing a Trap costs Florins and Mana Orbs. Check out the Siege Guide to learn more.
[/p][h2]Faction Guardians Improvement[/h2][p]We’re adding an option for you to Commission your Faction Guardians. This action permanently saves the Guardian Chamber’s bonus and frees up space in your Collection by removing the Champions from your account.
[/p][h2]Clan Quest Update[/h2][p]The Clan Quest requiring you to survive 150 turns or more in a Hydra Battle on Brutal Difficulty or above is being made easier. From now on, you'll only need to last 100 turns.
[/p][h2]Tavern Update[/h2][p]Rank Chickens and Feasts will now be stacked in the Tavern window to reduce unnecessary overcrowding. Also, Champions in the Vaults will be available when using the Instant Rank-Up feature. [/p][h2]
Advanced Quests Update[/h2][p]We’ve also added new Advanced Quests and an option to refresh some of the Quests in order to help you complete the ones you like. Look for new additions with the Quests' refresh at 00:00 UTC.[/p][p]Due to popular demand, we've updated the reward for the "Win 3 Artifacts/Accessories from clearing the Dungeons" Advanced Quest. Upon completing this Quest, you’ll now receive a 1-hour Free Gear Removal Booster, delivered to your Inbox with a 24-hour expiration time.[/p][h2]
Chest Rewards[/h2][p]We're introducing a new Chest Rewards tab, available both in the Battle Info menu and the end-of-battle window, which will be updated for Clan Boss battles. It will clearly show whether the damage you've dealt is enough to earn a Reward Chest.[/p][h2]
AI fixes[/h2][p]We have addressed AI bugs across a wide variety of locations in the game. Check out the full list of skills, Champions, and Bosses that have been affected in the news post titled A Smoother Game Awaits: AI Bugs Fixed.[/p][h2]
Chimera Rebalance[/h2][p]In short, we’re making the Ram Form a little bit easier to fight, and the Lion Form is becoming a bit more menacing. We’ve also adjusted some of the Trials for all Forms as well. For more details read the associated news post.[/p][h2]
Artifact Chest Rebalance[/h2][p]The chances of obtaining more valuable Artifacts have increased. The drop rates were adjusted based on Rank/Rarity, while the Set types remained unchanged. The following chests were affected:[/p][list][*][p]Exquisite Artifact Chest[/p][/*][*][p]Magnificent Artifact Chest[/p][/*][*][p]Elite Dragon Artifact Chest[/p][/*][*][p]Elite Ice Golem Artifact Chest[/p][/*][*][p]Elite Fire Knight Artifact Chest[/p][/*][*][p]Tag Arena Leagues Size QoL[/p][/*][*][p]The capacity of the Silver and Gold Tiers in Tag Team Arena has been increased.[/p][/*][/list][h2]

[/p][p]Increases the duration of all ally buffs by 1 turn. [/p][p]Fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 10%. Fills their Turn Meter by an additional 5% for each buff that had its duration increased by this skill.[/p][p]New version: [/p][p]Attacks all enemies. notes.title: RAID Digest (13.06.25)
notes.content:
[p]It's Friday the 13th, the veil between worlds feels especially thin, and the realm of Teleria is crawling with demonic horrors you'd rather not meet in a dark dungeon. However, we would like to remind you about a couple of features intended to help you deal with all sorts of dungeon-crawling inconveniences.[/p][p][/p][p]First, there are two new QoL features: Oil Mixer and Extract Mixer, which allow combining lesser items into larger ones, just like the Potion mixer does. You can access both features via a special icon at the bottom right corner of the screen while you're ascending Artifacts and Accessories, respectively.[/p][p][/p][p]Second, With the Coalition Event in full swing, don't forget to complete some Coalition Quests and claim rewards, as our community has nearly reached the ultimate milestone of 1 billion points. Don't disregard the Personal rewards either, as there are quite a few valuable items there as well, including an XP Barrel, Shards, and Skill Tomes.[/p][p][/p][p]So gear up, mix smart, tread carefully, and check out what else this Friday the 13th's RAID Digest has to offer.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bugs and fixes[/h2][list][*][p]When Embrys the Anomaly converts \[Stone Skin] buffs into the \[True Fear] debuffs with the A3 of his Base form “The Unmaking”, these debuffs become protected and so cannot be cleansed, even though this is not specified in the description of the Skill and was not intended for it. This is a bug, and starting from the next major update, the \[True Fear] debuff produced by this Skill will no longer be protected.[/p][/*][*][p]If Tholin Foulbeard manages to land \[Weaken] debuff on all enemies with his A1 "Demonbreaker" during an Ally Attack of his team, he can get an Extra Turn, despite the fact that this Extra Turn was not intended to occur in this scenario and it is not typical for other Champions as well to get an Extra turn during Ally and Counter Attacks. notes.title: RAID Digest (30.05.25)
notes.content:
While hordes of Demonspawn led by Kurosa prepare to sneak into Teleria through mysterious portals and spread chaos, we keep maintaining stability: what can be more stable than our regular #RAIDDigest. Let’s dive in! 

[h2]⚔️ Live Arena Seasons Points & Matchmaking Changes[/h2]

With the start of the next LA Season, we’ll be rolling out some updates to Live Arena Seasons Points, and matchmaking.

The first change is that the number of Season Points gained or lost in a battle will be adjusted.  It will depend on the point gap between you and your opponent. To put it briefly, when defeating a considerably weaker opponent, you’ll get fewer points; when losing a battle to a much higher-ranked player, you'll lose fewer points.  

The second change is that we are improving the matchmaking system of the Live Arena Seasons to decrease the chances of a match between accounts with a considerable difference in Season Points. 

All the details are coming next week in the corresponding in-game news, so stay tuned. 

[h2]Hard Faction Wars Challenge “Manipulate buff or debuff duration 20+ times”: Nuances [/h2]

Decreasing Bombs' duration doesn't count for the Hard Faction Wars challenge “Manipulate buff or debuff duration 20+ times” (for example, Glishak’s A2), as this particular effect [Bomb] is related to 'detonation' and not 'decreasing duration'. 

The same situation applies to the Poison and HP Burn Activations (for example, Artak, Dark Kael)—the “force tick”  does not count towards the Challenge because it doesn't reduce the duration of debuffs; it literally activates them. 

Another nuance you probably need to know about the Challenge is that it counts the number of effects triggered (Decrease/Increase duration or Decrease/Increase cooldown), not by how many turns the effect manipulated buffs/debuffs or skills.

 Here is an example:
[list]
[*] Let’s say there are 5 Champions in a battle, and each one has 2 Debuffs. 
[*] When you increase the duration of all Debuffs, it might seem like you’ll get 10 ticks of progress. But what actually counts toward the Challenge is the number of successfully triggered effects. 
[*] In this example, since the effect triggered on 5 Champions, that means 5 successful procs — which equals 5 points of Challenge progress.
[*] This is the same for reducing/increasing skill cooldowns
[/list]

[*] There is a nasty bug that causes Siege Preset slots for the Defense Team to disappear after deleting the preset that was assigned to the slot. The fix is planned for the nearest release. In the meantime, feel free to reach out to our Support team for help in removing the teams. 
[*] After reaching the Silver, Gold, or Platinum Clan League, players get the same notification repeatedly every time they visit the Clan window (Congratulations!). It should only be shown once. The bug will be fixed in one of the next releases. 
[*] The Aspect of Siroth Relic prevents the activation of Rotos the Lost Groom’s Spurn Oblivion skill when receiving fatal damage. We will fix it in the next release. 
[/list]

notes.title: RAID Digest (16.05.25)
notes.content:
Hello, Raiders! While some of you are trying the teeth on the Hard Mode of Faction Wars and others are just enjoying the spring vibes, we’ve prepared another issue of RAID Digest for you, in which we will mainly cover the recent updates. Without further ado, let’s start!

[h2]Faction Wars: Hard Mode [/h2]
As you know, the Hard Mode of Faction Wars was recently released in RAID. By the way, Hard Mode Challenges are available during battle in the Pause menu.

We don't want to impose too many limitations on players when exploring the Hard mode of the Faction wars. Thus, the Advanced Quests "Beat 1 Faction Wars Stage with at least 1 Rare Champion on your team" and "Win 3 Faction Wars Battles without losing a Champion" have been permanently removed. 

[h2]Progressive Chance Event with 2 different Unity Champions. How does it work? [/h2]
During Progressive Chance Events, all Unity Champions are added to the Shard pool with their normal drop rates. Selecting one Unity Champion for the boosted chance does not remove other Unity Champions from the pool, but x15 multiplier is applied only for the Champion chosen in the active slot.

[h2]Rework of Instant Poison/HP Burn Activation Effects[/h2]
The new effect is a rework of Instant Poison/HP Burn activation and will 'affect' four Champions: Zavia, Elenaril, Karam, and Polara.

After the rework, the poison damage will now benefit from Poison Sensitivity, the Lethal Dose blessing, and any relics, stones, or passives that enhance or reduce Poison damage, including those that add ignore effects like Stokk's. For example, with Zavia, her damage used to be calculated as Max HP damage. The number of poisons would be counted, their turn durations considered, removed, and converted into damage—which was then reduced by the 10% passive effect on Bosses. Now, her damage will be affected by passives that cut Poison damage by up to 90%, but overall, with the added bonuses, the numbers should still be much higher.

Champions that activate Poisons/Burns like Teodor or Gizmak in 1st form, won't be changed. They will still make a 1 tick of 1 turn of poison/burn.

[h2]Leaderboards Avatar Frames[/h2]
Some of you might have already noticed Leaderboards Avatar Frames in the game. That’s just a spoiler, they will become truly available later, with the release of the Leaderboards.

[h2]Bugs and Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] There is a known visual bug affecting Artifact selling, where the sold Artifact remains on the screen and results in an error when attempted to be sold again. We plan to fix it in the near future. In the meantime, clearing RAID application cache should resolve the issue.
[*] Cancel opponent search button doesn't work in Live Arena. We are investigating the problem. We will keep you informed.
[*] Right now Ash’nar Dragonsoul does not extend Debuffs other than HP Burn. That is incorrect behaviour. The fix is planned for the next big update.
[*] Using a Champion with the Relic Torch of Thralldom may cause a battle loading longer than usual. This is a known problem, and we are actively monitoring the situation. We will keep you updated.
[/list]
[h2]Clan vs Clan Tournament  and Personal Rewards[/h2]
The next installment of Clan vs Clan Tournament won’t feature Personal Rewards.

notes.title: RAID Digest (02.05.25)
notes.content:
Greetings and salutations. We are sure there are Dragons to slay, Tournaments to win, and Champions to train, but let's take a minute, send those pesky Champions to farm some Minotaur scrolls, and dive into our newest RAID Digest.

[h2]Relics Clarifications[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Deathdealer - “wearer’s attacks will always be critical” will prevent weak hits from the players, and even bypass the Poison cloud buff. However, other champion effects/reactions/passives that modify Critical Hits specifically, can change the Critical Hit into another type of hit or modify it.
[*] Wand of Submission - Currently, there is a small bug with the relic: “Irresistible debuffs reflected by the relic can be resisted.” We are working on a fix. 
[*] Quickstrike (gem) - the 10% dmg boost effect is for the first attack, not only the first hit. Additionally, this effect activates only before any of the Hydra heads take their turn. Exposed necks or newly re-spawned heads will also not be affected by it.
[*] Rolling Force (gem) - “ignore DEF” effect from this gem will be calculated after the Boss's passive damage cuts.
[/list]
[h2]Siege Clarification[/h2]
Winning a Siege has two victory conditions:
[list]
[*] Destroy the enemy’s Stronghold
[*] Earn more Victory Medals than the enemy Clan
[/list]
Both conditions must be fulfilled to win the siege. So, no winners by points, while the enemy Stronghold is still standing.

Location bonus: “Champions cannot be revived” completely prevents all types of revivals, and is not bypassed by “ignore block revive” abilities.

[h2]Unity Update and older Windows versions[/h2]
Sometime in mid-May, we'll be updating the Windows version of RAID: Shadow Legends on Plarium Play to Unity 6, meaning it will no longer be compatible with versions of Windows below Windows 10, version 21H1.
Please do not forget to update your Windows if you are using an older version.

[h2]Languages and game engines[/h2]
Due to some issues with the language-specific symbol registry, Arabic and Thai in-game chats may be unavailable at the moment. We are aware of this issue, and will implement a fix as soon as possible, most likely with the next big update.

[h2]Clan vs Clan Tournament[/h2]
The next Clan vs Clan Tournament will feature Personal rewards, Gilded Medallions, and most likely some snipers. So don't wait till the last minute and make your Clan Lead proud.

notes.title: New Update: Version 10.40.0
notes.content:
Update 10.40.0 is here, bringing Artifact Quick Craft, improvements to Siege and Relics, a new type of Tournament related to Gear Ascension, rebalances to Chimera Clan Quests, and more! Check out everything that’s coming below.

[h1]Relic Improvements[/h1]

We’re adding Relic Lore which can be found in the Relic Index. We’re also separating the Events Group into several themed groups for better understanding. First of these groups is the Alice’s Adventure Group, and there will be more Groups in the future when Relics are released as part of specific Events. We’re also implementing minor improvements in Relic Storage and Gemstone Storage, such as highlighting compatible Relic sockets when selecting a Gemstone.

[h1]Artifact Quick Craft and Autoselling Artifacts[/h1]

We’ve added a new feature to the Forge called Artifact Quick Craft. It allows you to simultaneously craft multiple Artifacts of one specific Set. To use the Quick Craft feature, you must have at least 1 slot free in either your Artifact Storage or Inbox.

You can customize how you use Quick Craft by setting the desired number of Artifacts you'd like to craft, and manage other settings to automatically sell Artifacts you don’t want to keep.

Artifacts obtained via Quick Craft (including any that are automatically sold) are counted towards any related Events, Tournaments, Missions, CvC or other in-game activities.

Read more about Artifact Quick Craft in the Guide: Forge.

[h1]Siege - Draw condition improvement[/h1]

We are constantly looking to improve Siege, and this time around, we’ve tackled the draw conditions. Now, if both Clans destroy each other’s Strongholds and also receive the same number of Victory Medals, then the Clan that protected the most Team slots in their own buildings will be declared the winner.

[h1]Gear Ascension Tournament[/h1]

We’re also introducing a new type of Tournament, called Gear Ascension Tournament. You’ll need to get as many Oils and Extracts as you can to earn Points, and pick up some great rewards!

[h1]Chimera Clan Quest rebalance[/h1]

Some of the Chimera Clan Quests we created turned out to be tougher than we thought. With that in mind, we’ve rebalanced some of them to make them a little easier - they’re still a challenge though!

[h1]Market Refresh button repositioning[/h1]

We’ve repositioned the Refresh Now button in the Market to avoid accidentally tapping it when trying to exit the Market.

[h1]Champion rebalance[/h1]

[h3]Ash'Nar Dragonsoul, Base Form[/h3]

6* Ascension bonus changed to SPD +10
[Skill 1 – Ignition Arc]
Old version:
Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. 
Each hit has a 25% chance to increase the duration of a [HP Burn] debuff on the target by 1 turn.
New version:
Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. 
Each hit has a 50% chance of increasing the duration of all debuffs on the target by 1 turn.
Each hit has a 100% chance to increase the duration of a [HP Burn] debuff on the target by 1 turn instead, if the initial chance does not activate.
[Skill 5 – By Fire Be Healed]
Old version:
Each active [HP Burn] debuff placed by this Champion increases their MAX HP by 5% (stacks up to 25%). 
[HP Burn] debuffs placed on allies heal them instead of damaging them.
New version:
Each [HP Burn] debuff placed by this Champion while in their Base Form increases their MAX HP and DEF by 5% (stacks up to 25% across both Forms and will not reset).
[HP Burn] debuffs placed on allies heal them instead of damaging them.
Allies deal 3% more damage for each active [HP Burn] debuff. If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate.

[h3]Ash'Nar Dragonsoul, Alternate Form[/h3]

[Skill 1 – Thunderstar]
Old version:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Each hit has a 35% chance of repeating once if the target is under a [HP Burn] debuff.
New version:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Has a 25% chance of repeating each hit.
Each hit also places a 60% [Decrease DEF] debuff for 2 turns.
[Skill 2 – Magma Geyser]
Old version:
Attacks 1 enemy. 
If the initial target is under a [HP Burn] debuff, will repeat the attack on all enemies. 
This repeated attack will ignore 20% of each target's DEF.
New version:
Attacks 1 enemy. 
Applies a [Debuff Spread] effect, taking all debuffs from the target and placing them on all enemies.
Then, repeats the attack on all enemies. Increases the duration of all debuffs on all enemies by 1 turn.
Both attacks will ignore 20% of each target's DEF.
[Skill 3 – Cataclysm Smash]
Old version:
Attacks all enemies. Before attacking, places a 60% [Increase DEF] buff and a 30% [Increase C. DMG] buff on this Champion for 2 turns. 
Then places a [Provoke] debuff for 1 turn on targets under a [HP Burn] debuff. If the target of this skill is a Boss under a [HP Burn] debuff, places a [Provoke] debuff for 2 turns instead. 
This attack cannot be a weak hit when hitting enemies under a [HP Burn] debuff.
New version:
Attacks all enemies. Before attacking, places a 60% [Increase DEF] buff and a 30% [Increase C. DMG] buff on all allies for 2 turns. 
Places a [Provoke] debuff for 1 turn. If the target of this skill is a Boss, places a [Provoke] debuff for 2 turns instead. 
This attack cannot be a weak hit when hitting enemies under a [HP Burn] debuff.
 [Skill 5 – By Fire Be Broken ]
Old version:
All of this Champion's skills will ignore 15% of the enemy's DEF if they are under a [HP Burn] debuff.
[HP Burn] debuffs placed on allies heal them instead of damaging them.
New version:
Each [HP Burn] debuff placed by this Champion's Base Form increases this Champion's MAX HP and DEF by 5% (stacks up to 25% across both Forms and will not reset).
All of this Champion's skills will ignore 20% of the enemy's DEF if they are under a [HP Burn] debuff.
[HP Burn] debuffs placed on allies heal them instead of damaging them.

[h3]Wurlim[/h3]

Aura changed to Increases Ally DEF in all Battles by 33%.
[Skill 1 – Winds of Winter]
Old version:
Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 30% chance of placing a [Freeze] debuff for 1 turn.
Places a [Perfect Veil] buff on the ally with the lowest HP for 2 turns if the [Freeze] debuff is placed. Places a [Veil] buff on the ally with the lowest HP for 1 turn if the [Freeze] debuff is blocked or resisted.
New version:
Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 30% chance of placing a [Freeze] debuff for 1 turn. This debuff cannot be resisted.
Places a [Perfect Veil] buff on the ally with the lowest HP for 2 turns.
[Skill 2 – Frostbite Blast]
Now places a 50% [Decrease ATK] debuff instead of a 25% [Decrease C. DMG] debuff.
[Ascended Skill 2 – Frostbite Blast]
Now places a 50% [Decrease ATK] debuff instead of a 25% [Decrease C. DMG] debuff.
[Skill 3 – Icegrave Armor]
Added effect: Has a 60% chance of placing a [Freeze] debuff on all enemies for 1 turn. This debuff cannot be resisted.

[list]
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused Champions under the [Sheep] debuff to appear as though they were utilising effects before transforming back to their regular form.

notes.title: RAID Digest (21.03.25)
notes.content:
Greetings, folks! Another two weeks have passed, and we are back with the news and clarifications in our new issue of the RaidDigest. While your Background Battles are rolling, grab a cup of coffee, make yourself comfortable, and let’s dive into it!

[h2]Background Battles Are Available For Everyone [/h2]
Good news! Two days ago, we finally opened Background Battles to all players. Thank you for your patience while we were gradually opening this feature to a bigger audience. 

Since all Raiders got access to it, we’d like to highlight a few things about the feature. 
[list]
[*] Selling gear is impossible directly from the Background Multi-Battle window: it is not a bug but a peculiarity of this feature.  All the obtained Artifacts/Accessories will be immediately added to your account, and you’ll be able to interact with them even before the Background Multi-Battles are finished. 
[*] A special warning when your Inbox is full. To prevent your Inbox from overflowing, there is a pop-up window with a heads-up that your Inbox is full before you start the Background Multi-Battle giving you a chance to clear out some space. 
[/list]
[h2] Bugs And Fixes [/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Gem Mine Hides Gems.[/b] Sometimes, the Mine is hiding generated Gems. Worry not, it is only a visual illusion. Gems are still being produced, and clicking on the Mine will let you collect them as usual. Our developers are planning to release a fix in one of the next releases. 
[*] [b]Saved Teams Cannot Be Edited.[/b] Some players get an error message when trying to edit Saved Teams on various locations. The developers are aware of the issue and are already preparing a fix to release it in the next big update. Meanwhile, as a temporary workaround, we suggest completely deleting a problematic Saved Team with the 'delete' button and rebuilding the team. 
[*] [b]The Power Of The [Deathbrand] Can Be Resisted. [/b]As you know, Champions under a [Deathbrand] receive the [Block Revive] debuff when killed. However, currently, high Resistance may prevent [Block Revive] from being landed on a target under [Deathbrand], which is a bug that we'll fix in one of the next releases.
[/list]
[h2]Faction Wars Area Bonuses And “Hard”  Faction Wars[/h2]
As mentioned in our latest What’s Next in RAID video (hope you liked it), we’re expanding Faction Wars by adding a Hard mode. A logical question arose: would the existing Faction Wars Area Bonuses work towards the upcoming Hard Faction Wars? 
Yes, absolutely! Existing Area Bonuses will work for Hard mode, so you can start preparing for it. 

[h2]Clan vs. Clan Tournament and Personal Rewards[/h2]
The next installment of Clan vs. Clan Tournament won't feature Personal Rewards.

notes.title: RAID Digest (07.03.25)
notes.content:
As Teleria marks its 6th Anniversary and your Champions revel in the festivities, we invite you to unwind with the first spring RAID Digest. Grab your favorite beverage, settle in, and see what's new in the realm!

[h2]Background Multi-Battles[/h2]

You might wonder where the promised Background Multi-Battles are, which should have been implemented into the game in the latest update. Worry not! Background Multi-Battles are being gradually rolled out to all players, so it may take a couple more weeks until you receive access to them. This is done to properly test the Live Server workload and to ensure everything works as it should.

We would like to emphasize that this is only one of the first steps towards time-saving optimizations. We're only getting started with this feature. Ideally, we want you to be able to fight in Arena and other game modes while your Background Multi-Battles are running. But we still have a lot to do before we can reach this goal.

[h2]Clarification on Live Arena Changes[/h2]

Let’s start with Seasonal League, which becomes unlocked for all players who have reached Gold League: 
[list]
[*] first and foremost, it is a separate feature, that’s why it won’t diminish your progress in Live Arena;
[*] winning a battle earns LA Points, with which you progress in both Seasonal and Gold Leagues;
[*] after reaching Gold League, you cannot drop back to Silver;
[*] gaining/losing Points is in accordance with Gold League balance;
[*] gaining or losing Points is counted for both General and Seasonal ratings;
[*] Seasonal League runs for a duration of 4 weeks, followed by a 2-week Mid-season break.
[/list]
By the way, starting from the latest update, we’ve increased the number of gained Points per victory in both LA Silver and Gold Leagues (for Silver to +7 Points, for Gold to +9 Points) and decreased the number of Points you lose for Defeat in LA Gold League to -3. The inactivity penalty was also decreased to -1 Point per day. In other words, earn more, lose less! (wink-wink)

[h2]Miscellaneous [/h2]
[list]
[*] The inconvenient placement of the Refresh button in the Market will be fixed in the next big update.
[*] There was a bug with Chronocube when this Relic granted not one, but multiple Turns to its wearer using Team Attack. It has been addressed and fixed. 
[*] We’ve seen that some Raiders can’t enter their nickname on the Anniversary page: https://lps.plarium.com/en/desktop/raid/bookshelf, which prevents them from claiming their reward for solving the puzzle. In order to get the personal promo code, please make sure that you enter the correct nickname (from your RAID account). In case you need help, please reach out to our Support team via the game, or at raid.support@plarium.com
[/list]
[h2]Clan vs. Clan Tournament and Personal Rewards[/h2]

The next 100th installment of Clan vs. Clan Tournament will be a festive one and will feature Personal Rewards. By the way, there will be a surprise, so sharpen the swords! (wink-wink)

Thanks for checking out today's RAID Digest. Have a great weekend ahead!

notes.title: New Update: Version 10.30.0
notes.content:
Update 10.30.0 is here! With this latest update to Raid, we’re introducing some much-requested quality-of-life updates to Siege and Progressive Chance Events, as well as new features like Live Arena Seasons and Background Multi-Battle. Check out everything that’s coming below.

[h2]Live Arena Seasons[/h2]

We’re introducing Live Arena Seasons! This is a time-limited Seasonal League available to players in Gold Tier where you can win Seasonal Rewards, new Variable Gear Sets, and more! That’s not all - we’ve also added Avatar Frames that you can obtain from Chests by finishing in 1st, 2nd-10th, and 11th-100th in Live Arena Seasonal Leagues.

We’re also adding a brand-new group of 8 Relics that can be crafted using Runed Obsidian. This new material can only be earned by participating in Live Arena Seasons.

The first Seasonal League will start on March 11, so prepare your Champions!

[h2]Background Multi-Battle[/h2]

Another feature we’re excited to introduce is Background Muti-Battle. This allows you to complete other in-game activities while your Champions are fighting. You can manage your account, summon Champions and Souls, or upgrade Gear, Skills, and Masteries. NOTE: You can’t make changes to Champions that are currently participating in a Background Multi-Battle, and you can’t run any other battles while a Background Multi-Battle is in progress.

We are currently testing the Background Multi-Battle feature to make sure there are no technical issues. Therefore, we plan to release the feature gradually to all players, so don’t worry if you don’t see the feature in-game just yet.

[h2]Clan Orders: Attack Priority[/h2]

Clan Leaders and Deputies can now place Attack Orders on buildings in a Siege, with either High, Medium, or Low Priority. This will help Clans better co-ordinate their attacks to focus on the buildings that are key to an opposing Clan’s defense.

[h2]Progressive Chance Event Enhancements[/h2]

You can now remove Champions from Summon Slots while maintaining the increased chances. A notification will warn you that if Summon Slots are empty, the Progressive Chance Event will be inactive, but your chances will remain the same if they have already been increased. Additionally, tapping and holding on a Champion’s icon will now take you to the Champion Index where you can learn more about them.

[h2]Artifact Storage Increase[/h2]

Added 100 more Slots to the Artifact and Accessory Storage.

notes.title: RAID Digest (07.02.25)
notes.content:
Greetings, Raiders!

After the fierce Siege battles and an eventful 10.20 release, we believe it’s time to sit back and enjoy our Friday RAID Digest. Without further ado - let’s start!

[h2]Hydra Quick Battles[/h2]

We introduced Hydra Quick Battles in the last release and want to address some common questions. Our goal with Hydra was to encourage team optimization and synergy.

To preserve player interaction, manual or semi-auto battles remain the best strategy for top results. Quick Battles are a time-saving tool for those willing to trade some efficiency for convenience. We recommend fine-tuning your teams first before testing them in Quick Battles.

Another point we would like to highlight regarding Quick battles is their duration. Unlike Demon Lord Quick Battles, the Hydra ones take a little longer (up to several minutes), as it takes time to model all those 1000 turns. 

Aspect of Siroth Relic and Its Effect on the Turn Meter Manipulation
In update 10.20, we introduced an Immunity skills fix. Now, when a Champion’s skill states they are “Immune” to certain debuffs or effects, they are truly immune to them.

There is one exception to the rule, though. Turn meter manipulation immunity protects Champions only from effects generated by the enemy. So effects from Relics such as Aspect of Siroth will still apply to the "immune" Champions. We will adjust the skill description to better reflect this caveat

[h2]Champion Rebalance Process  [/h2]

After each Champions rebalance, we often see the same questions, so we decided to clarify some of the aspects players were curious about.

Q: How do devs choose Champions to rebalance?
[list]
[*] Player feedback and in-game Champion ratings (now that it has been reset) are essential factors. Players know best the strong and weak sides of the Champion, so we prioritize Champions that players see as lacking and make appropriate changes. 
[*] History of rebalances. If the Champion already had a rebalance recently, they are less likely to receive another one.
[*] Older Champions have a higher priority than the new ones. However, it is a case-by-case process, so you can still see newer champions in our monthly rebalances.
[*] Void affinity also affects our decision. Void Legendaries are hard to come by, so we want them to meet player expectations and update their kits when possible.
[*] Champions from persistent Fusions or similar sources have a lesser priority for rebalance. They are mainly meant to introduce mechanics to players or fulfill somewhat niche roles on the team, so are less likely to receive a rebalance, as long as they serve that purpose.
[/list]
Q: Why do we not rebalance Champions more often?

Rebalance of a Champion is essentially the same process as creating a new one, with the added bonus that the Champion model is already in the game. While it may not look like it on the outside, it is a long process that involves work from multiple departments, and if we prioritize rebalancing more champions, it will significantly slow down our update release schedule. 

Rebalances are an endless process, so when we have any wiggle room in the update, we are more likely to include QoL features than an additional Champion rebalance.

Q: What do we take into account when choosing which Skills to rebalance?

Champion's intended role and function. Performance in that role is what we look into the most, so we boost stats and abilities that will make them better at the role. There are, of course, cases where Champion rework completely changes the skills or event roles of the Champions, but they are an exception, not the rule.

[h2]Clan vs. Clan Tournament and Personal Rewards[/h2]

Prepare your weapons and polish the armor, as the next installment of the Clan Tournament will come with personal rewards. May the strongest Clan hold the victory!

That’s all we have for today, take care, and we’ll see you in two weeks' time.

notes.title: New Update: Version 10.20.0
notes.content:
Update 10.20.0 is here! Check out Hydra Quick Battle, Campaign Super Raids, as well as various rebalances, improvements and fixes.

[h2]Hydra Quick Battle[/h2]

We are adding the highly-requested Quick Battle feature to the Hydra Clan Boss. This will be an option for players who want to fight the Hydra, but do not want to watch the whole battle play out in real-time. Quick Battle will be available for every Hydra difficulty, but must first be unlocked by dealing a set amount of damage using a single Hydra Key. 

The amount of damage needed to unlock Quick Battle corresponds to the amount of damage needed to receive the highest value Hydra Chest on that particular difficulty.

It is possible to unlock Quick Battle for several Hydra difficulties at once. For example, if a player achieves the Quick Battle unlock conditions on Brutal, it will also unlock Quick Battle on all Hydra difficulties below Brutal.

Team presets and general Hydra battle mechanics remain the same as if the player was running the battle normally in Auto mode. Once a player has initiated a Quick Battle, they cannot interfere with the battle until it finishes. 

Players can use Quick Battle a limited number of times during one weekly cycle. After the cycle is over, the number of Quick Battles resets automatically. It is possible to discard a Quick Battle result without spending a Hydra Key.

[h2]Campaign Super-Raids[/h2]

The good old Super Raids are now available in the Campaign. Save time, raid the Campaign, and get double the rewards!

[h2]Fragments Exchange Lock[/h2]

We’ve added a lock on the Champion Fragments Exchange feature to ensure that you can’t accidentally exchange a complete set of Champion Fragments you want to hold onto.

[h2]New Clan Levels + Clan Shop Items[/h2]

As part of this update, we’re also adding 5 more Clan levels, which all come with the extra Silver for completing Campaign Stages, additional Multi-Battles, and two more slots in the Clan Shop. There are also new resources available in the Clan Shop – Rank 1-3 Basalt, Gilded Medallions, and a Gemstone Box!

[h2]QoL: Champion names in the Soul Collection[/h2]

We’ve added Champion names and Faction icons to the Soul Collection window in the Altar of Souls and a few other places, so you won’t get confused about which Champion Souls you have.

[h2]QoL: Chaos Dust and Chaos Powder amount depiction[/h2]

We’ve also added a visual depiction of your total Chaos Dust and Chaos Powder on the victory screens when you tap the resource icon, so it’s easier to keep track of your resources.

[h2]QoL: Total Stats Window[/h2]

We changed the order of tabs in the Total Stats window in the Champion Collection, so now you can immediately see the stats of your Champion instead of having to switch a tab first.

[h2]Stage Requirement Filter[/h2]

Now, when you tap on the Champions button in the Team Selection screen when taking on Doom Tower Secret Rooms and Faction Wars, you’ll be taken to the Champions window with filters already active.

[h2]Filter out Faction Guardians[/h2]

We have added a new option for the Champion Filter in the Tavern and Empower Champions tab of the Guardian Ring, enabling you to hide Champions that are set as Faction Guardians.

[h2]AI Fixes[/h2]

We have addressed AI bugs across a wide variety of locations in the game. Check out the full list of skills, Champions, and Bosses that have been affected in the news post titled A Smoother Game Awaits: AI Bugs Fixed.

[h2]Immunity Skills fix[/h2]

Another change we’ve implemented is to make sure that when a Champion’s skill states that they are “Immune” to certain debuffs or effects, that they are truly immune to those things. If another skill states that it will place a guaranteed debuff, ignore a portion of the target’s RES, or ignore [Block Debuffs] buffs, it will still not bypass “Immunity”. You can find the affected Champions below:
[list]
[*] Leorius
[*] Roric
[*] Yumeko
[*] Hoskarul
[*] Ronda
[*] Tramaria
[*] Tatsu
[*] Krixia (both Forms)
[*] Acelin
[*] Marius
[*] Falmond
[*] Galleus (second Form)
[*] Aragaz
[*] He-Man
[/list]
[h2]Campaign Boss XP Rebalance[/h2]

We’ve rebalanced the amount of XP earned from Campaign Bosses when facing them on Normal, Hard, and Brutal difficulties, ensuring it’s more consistent. Now each Campaign Boss grants gradually more XP than the previous one.

[h2]New Relics[/h2]

We’ve also added a new batch of Relics, called the Clan Group. Discover 8 new Relics, which can be crafted from a new resource, Gilded Medallions, which themselves can be obtained in the Clan Shop.

[h2]Champion rebalance[/h2]

[h3]Ultan of the Shell[/h3]

[Skill 1 – Under the Skin]

- Skill changed

Old version: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Each hit has a 30% chance of placing a 60% [Decrease DEF] debuff for 2 turns. Each hit will also ignore 50% of the target's RES if Oella is on the same team.

If the target is under an [Increase DEF] buff, each hit has a 80% chance of removing it. This effect cannot be resisted.

New version: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Each hit has a 50% chance of placing a 60% [Decrease DEF] debuff for 2 turns. Each hit will also ignore 50% of the target's RES if Oella is on the same team.

If the target is under an [Increase DEF] buff, each hit has a 80% chance of removing it. This effect cannot be resisted.

[Skill 2 – Resurging Reversal]

- Skill changed

Old version: Removes all debuffs from this Champion. Heals this Champion by 20% of their MAX HP for each debuff removed.

Then, places a [Shield] buff on this Champion for 2 turns. The value of the [Shield] is equal to any surplus heal from this skill.

Finally, attacks 1 enemy. Will ignore [Shield] buffs. Damage increases by 20% for each debuff removed by this skill.

New version: Removes all debuffs from this Champion and heals them by 20% of their MAX HP. Heals this Champion by an additional 20% of their MAX HP for each debuff removed.

Then, places a [Shield] buff on this Champion for 2 turns. The value of the [Shield] is proportional to this Champion's ATK. The value of the [Shield] also increases by 5% for each debuff removed.

Finally, attacks 1 enemy. Will ignore [Shield] buffs. Damage increases by 20% for each debuff removed by this skill.

- Damage multiplier increased.

[Skill 3 – Somnolence Spores]

- Skill changed

Old version: Attacks all enemies. Has a 100% chance of placing a [Sleep] debuff for 1 turn. Will ignore 50% of the target's RES if Oella is on the same team.

Fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 15% whenever a [Sleep] debuff placed by this skill expires.

New version: Attacks all enemies.

Has a 100% chance of placing a [Sleep] debuff for 1 turn and a 30% [Decrease SPD] debuff for 2 turns. If Oella is on the same team, will place a [Stun] debuff instead of [Sleep], and ignore 50% of each target's RES.

Fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 15% whenever a [Sleep] or [Stun] debuff placed by this skill expires.

If Oella is on the same team, grants this Champion an Extra Turn.

- Damage multiplier increased.

[h3]Konstantin the Dayborn[/h3]

[Skill 1 – Sword of Suns]

- Skill changed

Old version: Attacks 1 enemy. Places an extra hit if the target is under any debuff.

New version: Attacks 1 enemy.

Places a 60% [Decrease DEF] debuff for 2 turns. This debuff cannot be resisted when Vlad the Nightborn is on the same team.

Places an extra hit if the target is under any debuff.

[Skill 2 – Rune Shatter]

- Skill changed

Old version: Attacks all enemies 2 times. Each hit will ignore 10% of each target's DEF for every [Leech], [Decrease DEF], and [Block Active Skills] debuff they are under.

New version: Attacks all enemies 2 times. Each hit will ignore 15% of each target's DEF.

Each hit will ignore an additional 10% of each target's DEF for every [Leech], [Decrease DEF], and [Block Active Skills] debuff they are under.

If a target is under [Leech], [Decrease DEF], and [Block Active Skills] debuffs simultaneously, each hit will ignore 75% of their DEF instead.

[Skill 3 – Quietude]

- Skill changed

Old version: Attacks 1 enemy. Before attacking, steals all buffs from the target, then transfers all debuffs from this Champion to the target.

Decreases the cooldown of the Quietude skill by 2 turns if this attack kills an enemy.

New version: Attacks 1 enemy. Before attacking, steals all buffs from the target and transfers all debuffs from this Champion to the target. This effect cannot be resisted when Vlad the Nightborn is on the same team.

Resets the cooldown of this skill if the target is killed.

- Aura changed

Old version: Increases Ally ATK in Arena battles by 30%.

New version: Increases Ally ATK in Arena battles by 35%.

[h2]Improvements and battle fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when Stokk the Broken was involved in a battle against the Hydra.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused the Scarab King’s HP bar appear empty when it wasn’t, when King Gallcobar was involved in the battle.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented players from fusing Dawncaller Sabitha in the Portal until the Attack phase in the current Siege was over, if that Champion had been used in two Siege battles.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Nell Blackteeth’s Blackteeth's Buffet skill to not work correctly after Arbiter used her Mentor of Heroes skill.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a Resisted notification to pop up when Marius the Gallant used his Death or Glory skill against enemies with no buffs.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused the highest possible drops from Stage 30 of the Event Dungeon to display incorrectly.
[*] Fixed a bug with the additional damage calculation in Chronicler Adelyn's Perceive Weakness skill.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Chimera’s Ram Form to not prioritize attacking Champions under the [Duel] effect.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Champions to not attack decapitated Hydra Heads when battling on Auto.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Equalize Turn Meter effect in Losan K'Leth’s Spirit Calculus skill to equalize Losan K'Leth’s Turn Meter  when fighting against the Hydra.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Lady Noelle’s Cryomantic Queen skill to decrease an enemy’s SPD, even if they are not under a Freeze debuff.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Champions battling on Auto to use Ally Attack skills against Hydra Heads that were under a Serpent’s Will buff.  
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Aspect of Siroth Relic to reduce the damage, but not reduce a Champion’s Turn Meter if that Champion is immune to Turn Meter reduction effects.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused item frames in the Clan Shop to display incorrectly.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Savage, Stun, and Fury Artifacts to not appear in the Market.
[/list]

notes.title: RAID Digest (10.01.25)
notes.content:
Queen of Hearts has brought havoc into the realms of Teleria and entrenched herself in the Event Dungeon, though judging by the grim resolve of Alice (and her menacing enormous sword) that bizarre regime won't last uncontested for long. Well, heads will roll, that's for sure.
