notes.title: New Update: Version 8.50.0
notes.content:
[h1]New Update: Version 8.50.0[/h1]

Tavern and Clan improvements, Epic Empowerment, and more!

With update 8.50.0, we are streamlining upgrading Champions, adding Epic Empowerment, rebalancing Champions, and more. See the full breakdown below.

[h2]Tavern Improvements[/h2]

We have made some improvements to the Tavern, making it easier than ever to upgrade your Champions. We’ve also added the Champion Filter to the Tavern to help find the Champions you want to upgrade.

[h3]Instant Upgrade[/h3]

We are introducing the Instant Upgrade function that lets you instantly upgrade a Champion's level using Common and Uncommon Champions of Rank 2 or lower. Once you tick the Instant Upgrade checkbox in the Tavern, the game will filter your Champion list to ensure that it only selects Champions that meet the criteria and can be sacrificed.

[b]The following will not be selected:[/b]

[list]
[*] Locked Champions
[*] Champions that can be used to Fuse another Champion, if they have warnings turned on
[*] Common and Uncommon Champions of Rank 3 or higher
[*] Champions with Tags applied
[*] Champions who are currently in Classic or Tag Team Arena Defense
[*] Champions who are currently in the Sparring Pit
[*] Champions who are currently in Saved Teams
[/list]

You can also manually deselect Champions from the list by tapping on them.

[h3]Instant Rank Up[/h3]

Instant Rank Up allows you to increase the Rank of several Champions at once, via the Instant Rank Up button in the Tavern. In the Instant Rank Up window, you can see Champions who can be instantly ranked up as well as Champions and Chickens that will be used as rank up material.

[b]The following Champions will not be used as Rank Up material:[/b]

[list]
[*] Locked Champions
[*] Champions that can be used to Fuse another Champion, if they have warnings turned on
[*] Champions who are currently in the Sparring Pit
[*] Champions who are assigned as Faction Guardians
[*] Champions who are currently in the Master or Reserve Vault
[*] Empowered Champions
[*] Champions who are currently in Classic or Tag Team Arena Defense
[*] Champions who have reached maximum level in their current Rank
[/list]

You can use a special Filter to set rules as to which Champions can be used as Rank Up material and in which order they will be chosen. You can find more information in the Instant Rank up guide, which can be accessed via the Info button in the Instant Rank Up window.

[h3]Skill upgrade improvements[/h3]

All Skill Tomes of a certain rarity are now stored in one slot. When upgrading Champion’s skills, you can use a slider to set the number of Skill Tomes you want to use. You can also use the MAX button to use the maximum number of available Skill Tomes.

[h3]Champion Ascension improvements[/h3]

When Ascending a Champion, you can now upgrade several Ascension levels at once using a slider or the MAX button.

[h3]Champion Filter[/h3]

The Champion Filter is now available in the Tavern, allowing you to view all Champions in both Vaults, upgrade them, or use them as upgrade material.

[h2]Epic Empowerment[/h2]

We’ve added the ability to empower Epic Champions! Now, Epic Champions as well as Legendary and Mythical Champions, can be Empowered using their own duplicates. Empowering Champions makes them significantly stronger by giving them permanent Stat boosts.

[h2]Redesigned News window[/h2]

We’ve redesigned the News window so that it now has 2 tabs: Featured News and General News. The Featured News tab will display more important news so you won’t miss anything important. 

[h2]Expanded immunity list for Bosses[/h2]

We’ve added the [Enfeeble] debuff to each Boss’ list of immunities, making them all immune to that debuff. 

[h2]Clan improvements[/h2]

We’ve added a new Clan role - Lieutenant - as well as some quality-of-life improvements. One of those improvements focuses on allowing those with a specific role in a Clan to send a recruitment message to the Global Chat.

[h2]Numbers UX update[/h2]

Numbers above 99,999 are now rounded using letters K (for thousands), M (for millions), and B (for billions) throughout the game UI. Number formats (dots, spaces, and commas) are also adjusted according to the rules of each in-game language.

[h2]Champion rebalance[/h2]

[b]Hakkorhn Smashlord[/b]

[Skill 2 – Rallying Bellow]

- Skill cooldown reduced from 4 to 3 turns.

[Ascended skill 2 – Rallying Bellow]

- Skill cooldown reduced from 4 to 3 turns.

[Skill 3 – Blood Offering]

- Skill changed

Old version: Sacrifices HP equal to 25% of this Champion's MAX HP, then attacks all enemies. Damage inflicted is equal to 50% of this Champion's MAX HP. This attack is always a normal hit. 

The HP sacrifice will happen even if it kills this Champion.

New version: Attacks all enemies.

Places a [Shield] buff on all allies for 2 turns. The value of the [Shield] is equal to 20% of the damage dealt.

- Damage multiplier decreased.

[b]Claidna[/b]

[Skill 1 – Touch of Slumber]

- Chance of placing a [Sleep] debuff increased from 50% to 80%.

[Skill 2 – Lost In The Woods]

- Effect added: Restores 100% of each ally's destroyed MAX HP.

Old version: Has a 75% chance of placing a 30% [Decrease SPD] debuff and a [Leech] debuff on all enemies for 2 turns. 

Also heals all allies by 20% of this Champion's MAX HP.

New version: Has a 75% chance of placing a 30% [Decrease SPD] debuff and a [Leech] debuff on all enemies for 2 turns.

Restores 100% of each ally's destroyed MAX HP, then heals all allies by 20% of this Champion's MAX HP.

[Skill 3 – Otherworld Infusion]

- Effect added: Removes all debuffs from all allies.

Old version: Places a [Block Debuffs] buff and a [Revive on Death] buff on all allies for 2 turns.

New version: Removes all debuffs from all allies, then places a [Block Debuffs] buff and a [Revive on Death] buff on them for 2 turns.

[Skill 4 – Fey Monarch [P]]

- Skill changed

Old version: Has a 30% chance of completely blocking the incoming damage of the first hit of an attack. Occurs once per turn.

New version: Has a 30% chance of completely blocking the incoming damage of the first hit of an attack on a random ally. Occurs once per turn.

[h2]Other improvements and battle fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Amius the Lunar Archon to not use their Lunar Storm and Rampant Chaos skills.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused the VFX for Gizmak the Terrible’s Flames of Resentment skill to clip through the ground during battles in the Gold Tier of Classic Arena.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused enemy shadows to disappear and reappear in Potion Dungeons.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused Champions to appear burnt after a [HP Burn] debuff expired on them, if that debuff was placed by a Champion with the Incinerate Blessing.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Kaja the Wry to make a separate revive attempt for Timit the Fool when using their Back With A Bang skill.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused [Shield] buffs granted by Artifacts to not be displayed on Sun Wukong’s HP bar.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Siegfrund the Nephilim’s Metamorph [P] skill to activate before his Stay the Blade [P] skill when his whole team received fatal damage, causing Siegfrund to transform into his Alternate Form and die immediately.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Aphidus the Hivelord to not use their Blisterbug Horde skill against the Demon Lord on Auto if they had three or more allies.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused buffs stolen by Borgoth the Scarab King to be displayed after their duration had ended.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Siphi the Lost Bride to resist [Provoke] debuffs placed by Alaz the Sunbearer’s Searing Glare skill, even if Siphi had less than 50% HP.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed [Shield] buffs from Artifacts to be spread by the [Buff Spread] effect.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Head of Decay’s Almighty Decay [P] skill to destroy 15% of a Champion’s potential MAX HP, rather than their current MAX HP as intended.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Fatalis Blademaster to be able to damage Dreadbombs with their True Charged Slash skill.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Borgoth the Scarab King’s Easy Prey [P] skill to not activate when damaged by an AoE attack when Borgoth was not the primary target.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Hydra battles to end in an error when the turn limit was reached when Wallmaster Othorion was on the team.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused the reward notification for completing the “Connect your account to a Plarium ID” Quest to display incorrectly.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused Area Bonuses to not be reflected in a Champion’s stats in the Team Setup window.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Champions using the Slayer Set to be able to exceed 10% of Bosses' MAX HP when dealing damage.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused an opponent leaving a Live Arena battle to not contribute to any “Win [x] Live Arena Battles” Quests.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused the [Increase SPD] buff to display incorrectly in battle.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused the camera in the Cursed City to move to a different location after closing any Stage on any difficulty.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a user to see chat messages from a banned user, including those containing banned words.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused an offer in the Shop that had been previously purchased to appear as though it had already been purchased again. 
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Tournaments and Events to stop working on Android devices with a version of Android 7.0.0 or earlier.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused offers in the Shop to be displayed incorrectly.
[/list]

notes.title: New Update: Version 8.40.0
notes.content:
[h1]New Update: Version 8.40.0[/h1]

With update 8.40.0, we’re reworking the Impulse and Zeal Artifact Sets, as well as rebalancing Champions and much more! 

We’ve got four new Champions joining the fight for Teleria, including two Mythical Champions in The Calamitus and Toshiro the Bloody, a Legendary High Elf called Wallmaster Othorion, and the first Sacred Order Champion with Faction Unity skills, Falmond Mournsword! Jump in-game now to check them all out, and read their unique lore via the Champion Lore button. 

You can see the full breakdown of Update 8.40.0 below:

[h2]Impulse and Zeal Set Rework[/h2]

We’ve changed how the Live Arena-exclusive Impulse and Zeal Artifact Sets work, turning them into 2-piece Sets while adjusting their Set Bonuses accordingly. 

Impulse will now offer a 12% increase to the wearer’s Speed, as well as a 12% chance to reduce a random skill’s cooldown by 1 turn. 

Zeal now grants its wearer a 20% increase to C. DMG, as well as a gradual increase to damage depending on how much HP the wearer has. At 100% HP, the wearer’s damage increases by 12%, and at 1% HP the damage increases by 0.12%. It’s 3% for every 25% HP the wearer has.

[h2]Champion rebalance
[/h2]
[h3][b]Queen Eva[/b][/h3]

[Skill 1 – Cauterize]

- Skill changed

Old version: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 50% chance of placing a 100% [Heal Reduction] debuff for 2 turns.

New version: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 70% chance of placing a 100% [Heal Reduction] debuff and a [Block Buffs] debuff for 2 turns. Has an extra 15% chance of inflicting a critical hit.

- Damage multiplier increased.

[Skill 2 – Ancient Curse]

- Skill changed

Old version: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Enemies killed by this skill cannot be revived.

New version: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Ignores 50% of the target's DEF. Has an extra 15% chance of inflicting a critical hit. 

Enemies killed by this skill cannot be revived.

- Damage multiplier increased.

[Skill 3 – Energy Drain]

- Damage multiplier increased.

[Ascended skill 3 – Energy Drain]

- Damage multiplier increased.

[h3][b]Minaya[/b][/h3]

[Skill 2 – Mending Ways]

- Skill changed

Old version: Attacks 1 enemy. Heals this Champion and the ally with the lowest HP by 10,000 HP. Has a 75% chance of placing a 100% [Heal Reduction] debuff on all enemies for 2 turns.

New version: Attacks 1 enemy. Heals this Champion and the ally with the lowest HP by 30% of this Champion's MAX HP. Has a 75% chance of placing a 100% [Heal Reduction] debuff and a [Leech] debuff on all enemies for 2 turns.

These debuffs cannot be resisted if Khoronar is on the same team.

[Skill 3 – Beauty's Allure]

- Skill changed

Old version: Heals all allies by 40% of their MAX HP. Places a [Block Debuffs] buff for 2 turns on Champions under [Increase DEF] buffs.

If a Champion is fully healed by this Skill, also places a [Shield] buff on them for 2 turns equal to 25% of the Champion's HP.

New version: Heals all allies by 40% of their MAX HP. Places a [Block Debuffs] buff on all allies for 2 turns.

If a Champion is fully healed by this skill, also places a [Shield] buff on them for 2 turns equal to 25% of the Champion's HP.

[Skill 4 – Lover's Sacrifice [P]]

- Skill changed

Old version: Fills the Turn Meters of all allies by 20% when this Champion is killed. Revives this Champion with 75% HP when killed if Khoronar is on the same team.

New version: Fills the Turn Meters of all allies by 20% and heals them by 20% of this Champion's MAX HP when this Champion is killed. 

Revives this Champion with 75% HP when killed if Khoronar is on the same team.

[h2]Other improvements and fixes[/h2]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bambus Fourleaf will now place a [Sleep] debuff on himself with any of his active skills even if he is already under 10 debuffs.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused an error when players tried to find an opponent in Live Arena.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused the [Hex] debuff to appear to be placed first by Kuldath’s Stoke the Flames skill.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Clan members’ fight results to be duplicated when participating in the Hydra Clash.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused Alaz the Sunbearer to remain standing when killed in the Doom Tower.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Borgoth’s Easy Prey [P] skill to activate when attacked by Miscreated Monster’s Lightning Storm skill.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused a Mirror Copy of Sun Wukong to appear with a [Block Passive Skills] debuff when fighting Astranyx the Dark Fae.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Polymorph Blessing to apply the [Sheep] debuff when the attacking enemy placed a [Block Revive] debuff.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Lonatharil’s  Flicker Barrier skill to place a [Shield] buff before attacking Borgoth.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Wight Queen Ankora’s Queen Consort [P] skill to not increase the Turn Meter when activated.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Wight King Narses to attack the Hydra twice with his Desecration Blast skill, even when the Hydra lacked [Shield] or [Strengthen] buffs.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused  Wight King Narses’ Spirits, Claim You skill to grant 2 Extra Turns instead of 1.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Harima’s Celestial Awe skill to activate twice after killing Ultimate Deathknight and another enemy using the Purgative Punishment skill.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Wight King Narses and Karnage the Anarch not to place [Block Revive] debuffs while being under [Enfeeble] debuffs.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Fyna, Blade of Aravia to not place [Increase C. RATE] buffs on her allies with the Exalted Lineage skill when there were more than 3 High Elves on the team.

[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash after Tuhanarak used her Radiant Suffering skill to spread the [Pain Link] debuff placed by Gizmak the Terrible’s Ungodly Fury skill to all Hydra Heads. 
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Togron the Conjoined’s Fill Your Bellies [P] skill to increase the MAX HP of Astranyx the Dark Fae when cloned as a Mirror Copy.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some Clan Quests to show as ‘Available’ when already claimed by another player.

notes.title: New Update: Version 8.30.0
notes.content:
With update 8.30.0, we’re adding new Progress Missions, new Area Bonuses at the Great Hall, and a Battle Counter in Classic Arena, as well as rebalancing Champions and much more! See the full breakdown below.

[h2]New Progress Missions[/h2]

We’re adding new Progress Missions to reflect all the awesome content we’ve added to the game in the past year or so.

There are 180 new Missions coming, focused on Hard Mode Dungeons, Live Arena, Cursed City, and more! You’ll be able to get your hands on rewards for finishing each Mission, with milestone rewards coming after completing 60, 120, and all 180 Missions. Completing all of these new Missions will give you a new free Void Legendary Champion - Marius the Gallant!

[b]Marius the Gallant[/b]
Rarity: Legendary
Type: DEF
Affinity: Void
Faction: Skinwalkers

[b]Note: [/b]You can complete Ramantu Missions and Marius Missions simultaneously, but only after completing all of the Arbiter Missions. 

[h2]New Area Bonuses[/h2]

We have expanded the Area Bonuses feature of the Great Hall! Now, you can also get stat boosts in Faction Wars, the Doom Tower, the Iron Twins Fortress, the Sand Devil's Necropolis, the Phantom Shogun's Grove, and the Cursed City.

[h2]Battle Counter[/h2]

We’re adding a Battle Counter to the Classic Arena. It will show you how many Offense Battles you need to complete in order to stay in your current Arena Tier after the Ranking Period ends.

Note: Staying in Platinum Tier requires Arena Points, and is therefore not dependent on the number of battles initiated.

[h2]Inbox Sorting[/h2]

We’re also adding a new Sorting option to the Inbox. From now on, you can sort items by the date they were received, or by their expiration date.

[h2]Renaming Rathalos Set[/h2]

We have renamed and redesigned the Rathalos Set into the Slayer Set, and Rathalos Material into Slayer Scales, following the end of our collaboration with the Monster Hunter franchise. Any existing Gear or materials will be converted, and any converted resources from the collaboration will be compatible with the newly-named resources. The balance of the Gear Set will remain the same.

[h2]Champion rebalance[/h2]

[b]Little Miss Annie[/b]

[Skill 1 – Pretty Nails]
- Skill changed.
Old version: Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. Each hit has a 50% chance of placing a 100% [Heal Reduction] debuff for 2 turns.

New version: Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. Each hit has a 50% chance of placing a 100% [Heal Reduction] debuff and a 60% [Decrease DEF] debuff for 2 turns.

[Skill 2 – Hollow Doll]
- Skill changed.
Old version: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Places a 50% [Increase ATK] buff on this Champion for 2 turns before attacking if the target is under a [Shield] buff. Will ignore 25% of the target's DEF if the target is under a [Shield] buff. 

Places a [Perfect Veil] buff on this Champion for 2 turns if this attack kills an enemy.

Fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 30% if this attack does not kill the target.

New version: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Before attacking, places a 50% [Increase ATK] buff on this Champion for 2 turns. Will ignore 25% of the target's DEF. 

Also places a [Perfect Veil] buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

Then, fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 30%.

[Skill 3 – Playdate]
- Skill changed.
Old version: Attacks 1 enemy. Will ignore 25% of the target's DEF if the target has higher DEF than this Champion. Destroys the target's MAX HP by 25% of the damage inflicted if the target has higher MAX HP than this Champion.

Will repeat attack a second time if the target has both higher DEF and higher MAX HP than this Champion.

New version: Attacks 1 enemy. Will ignore 25% of the target's DEF. Destroys the target's MAX HP by 25% of the damage inflicted.

Will repeat the attack if the target has both higher DEF and higher MAX HP than this Champion.

Also places a [Revive On Death] buff on this Champion for 2 turns if this attack kills an enemy.

[Skill 5 – Magical Heart [P]]
- Skill changed.
Old version: Each hit has a 50% chance of decreasing the target's Turn Meter by 5% and a 100% chance of destroying the target's MAX HP by 5% of the damage inflicted when attacking enemies under [Heal Reduction] debuffs.

Also heals this Champion by 5% of the damage inflicted when attacking enemies under [Heal Reduction] debuffs.

[Will not heal from damage inflicted by Masteries]

New version: Each hit has a 50% chance of decreasing the target's Turn Meter by 10% and a 100% chance of destroying the target's MAX HP by 10% of the damage inflicted when attacking enemies under [Heal Reduction] or [Decrease DEF] debuffs.

Also heals this Champion by 10% of the damage inflicted when attacking enemies under [Heal Reduction] or [Decrease DEF] debuffs.

[Will not heal from damage inflicted by Masteries]

[b]Supreme Athel[/b]

[Skill 1 – Exemplar of Stoicism]
- Damage multiplier increased.

[Skill 2 – Cold Company]
- Skill changed.
Old version: Attacks all enemies. Will ignore [Strengthen], [Ally Protection] and [Unkillable] buffs on enemies under a [Freeze] debuff. 

Then, has a 100% chance of placing a [Freeze] debuff for 1 turn.

New version: Attacks all enemies. Before attacking, has a 100% chance of placing a [Freeze] debuff for 1 turn.

Will ignore [Strengthen], [Ally Protection] and [Unkillable] buffs, as well as 20% of the target's DEF when attacking enemies under a [Freeze] debuff.

- Damage multiplier increased.

[Skill 3 – Ever Faithful]
- Skill changed.
Old version: Places a 50% [Increase ATK] buff, a 30% [Increase C. RATE] buff and a [Shield] buff on this Champion for 3 turns, then grants an Extra Turn. The value of the [Shield] is proportional to this Champion's ATK.

New version: Places a 50% [Increase ATK] buff, a 30% [Increase C. RATE] buff, a [Shield] buff, and a 50% [Increase ACC] buff on this Champion for 3 turns, then grants an Extra Turn. 

The value of the [Shield] is proportional to this Champion's ATK.

[b]Siegfrund the Nephilim, Base Form[/b]

[Skill 1 – Excoriating Edge]
- Damage multiplier increased.

[Skill 2 – Seraphic Wave]
- Damage multiplier increased.

[Skill 3 – Rage of the Nephilim]
- Skill changed.
Old version: Attacks 1 enemy. Will attack all remaining enemies with any surplus damage if the initial target is killed. 

Fully heals this Champion if the initial hit kills an enemy.

New version: Attacks 1 enemy. Ignores 50% of the target's DEF. Will attack all remaining enemies with any surplus damage if the initial target is killed. 

Fully heals this Champion if the initial hit kills an enemy.

- Damage multiplier increased.

[Skill 5 – Stay the Blade [P]]
- Skill changed.
Old version: If this Champion is about to get killed by a fatal hit, blocks incoming damage and places a [Block Damage] buff on this Champion for 1 turn. 

Then, heals this Champion by 50% of their MAX HP and fills their Turn Meter by 100%.

New version: If this Champion is about to get killed by a fatal hit, blocks incoming damage and places a [Block Damage] buff on this Champion for 2 turns. 

Then, heals this Champion by 50% of their MAX HP and fills their Turn Meter by 100%.

[b]Siegfrund the Nephilim, Alternate Form[/b]

[Skill 3 – Light of the Beyond]
- Skill changed.
Old version: Revives all dead allies with 50% HP and 50% Turn Meter, then places a [Block Damage] buff on all allies except this Champion for 1 turn.

New version: Revives all dead allies with 50% HP and 50% Turn Meter, then places a [Block Damage] buff on all allies for 2 turns.

[h2]Other improvements and battle fixes[/h2]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] When summoning 10 Champions or Souls, or crafting 10 Artifacts, Tournament Points will now be shown after everything has been displayed.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Acelin the Stalwart’s Behold the Banner skill to be instantly activated when someone attempted to revive allies, even if all allies were already alive.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a healing loop when the passive skills of Amius the Lunar Archon’s Base Form and Ultimate Deathknight activated in the same battle.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Zinogre Blademaster’s Zinogre Essence skill to prevent death when receiving fatal damage from debuffs.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Countess Lix’s Mire of Misery skill to not attempt to place debuffs on each hit.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused the Total Damage to display incorrectly when hitting the Hydra with Ally Attack skills.
[*] Karnage the Anarch’s skill descriptions now mention that damage is based on both ATK and ACC.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused players to be unable to participate in a CvC Tournament if they had started Stage 1 of the Sewers of Arnoc when CvC matchmaking had begun.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the “Possible drops from Stage” window to not close correctly.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused no rewards to be displayed after finishing a Battle in various game modes.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a Glyph to be unusable after reworking a piece of Gear.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused Shard and Event icons over the Portal in the Bastion to display incorrectly.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused the Rathalos Set in Gear Storage to display incorrectly.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a purchase error message to appear when minimizing the game right after making a purchase via Google Play.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that, in certain offers in the Shop, caused a Champion icon to display incorrectly and not direct players to the Index when tapped.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Team Setup instructions to stop working when a Champion in the Team Setup reached Max Level during a Multi-Battle sequence.

notes.title: New Update: Version 8.20
notes.content:
With update 8.20.0, we are adding a new type of skill and the opportunity to exchange unused Champion Fragments for useful resources. We are also making Super Raids permanent, as well as implementing some other improvements and fixes. You can check the full breakdown of these changes in this piece of news.

But that’s not all - we are also rebalancing Blessings and increasing your chances of summoning Perfect Souls for specific Champions on your Wishlist. We’ll post a separate piece of news about these changes, so keep an eye out for that!

[h2]Faction Unity Skills[/h2]

Faction Unity skills are a brand-new type of skill that have their power enhanced when a player has multiple Champions from the same Faction on their team. The more allies from the same Faction, the more powerful a Faction Unity skill becomes. Champions who have Faction Unity skills will also have enhanced Aura skills that increase two stats rather than one.

Champions with Faction Unity skills are important figures from Teleria’s past and present, related to each Faction. As these Champions are particularly special, they won’t normally be summonable from Shards and will only be available from select in-game events. Keep an eye on the News to find out how and when you can get them, and don’t miss out on getting the first Champion with Faction Unity skills - Acelin the Stalwart!

[h2]Exchanging Champion Fragments[/h2]

Over the years, you might have accumulated hundreds of Champion Fragments with no way to use them. Well, now you can - introducing Fragment Exchange!

You can now swap your unused Champion Fragments for Exchange Points if you are unable to earn more Fragments for that specific Champion. You can then spend your Exchange Points on Fragment Exchange Chests. Each Chest contains useful items that will help you progress, as well as Fragments of a unique Legendary Champion from the Sacred Order, Highmother Maud. Head to the Fragment Summon tab in the Portal to find out the details.

[h2]Live Arena adjustments[/h2]

Players in Gold I and Gold II will now lose 3 Live Arena Points per battle loss instead of 4. We’ve also shortened the maximum battle duration from 30 to 20 minutes.

[h1]Permanent Super Raids[/h1]

Super Raids will now be permanently available in the Doom Tower, Faction Wars, Gear Dungeons, and Gear Ascension Dungeons. Also, if you activate Super Raids during a CvC Tournament, the CvC Points you receive will be doubled.

[h2]Clan Insignia improvements[/h2]

We have introduced several improvements related to Clan Insignia:

[list]
[*] The correct information about the opponent’s Clan (including the correct Clan Insignia) will now be displayed after finding an opponent in Live Arena.
[*] Clan Insignia will now be displayed in the Classic Arena, Tag Team Arena, and Live Arena battle result windows.
[*] We have also added the Clan Insignia creation rules to the Clan Insignia guide.
[/list]

[h2]Other improvements and battle fixes[/h2]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now access our communities on Facebook and Discord from the server maintenance window.
[*] If a Champion required for Fusion is currently available via Events or Tournaments, it will now be shown in the Champion Origin pop-up in the Fusion tab.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused Vitrius the Anointed’s By My Hand! skill animation to not play fully when he has stacks of Lightning Orb.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused Gharol Bloodmaul’s HP bar to appear empty after healing her from 1 HP when under the effects of an [Unkillable] buff.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Ostrox Boneglaive’s Pain Reversal skill to activate the Shadow Heal Mastery.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused Amius the Lunar Archon’s Base Form skill icons to display while under an [Eclipse] buff.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Mirror Copies summoned by Astranyx the Dark Fae in the Cursed City to not mirror your Team’s order when there are less than 5 Champions on your Team.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Strategos Islin’s Protect The Troops [P] skill to not heal allies correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Karilon the Ringer’s Polar Vortex skill to not fully deplete the Turn Meters of enemies that received a [Freeze] debuff from this skill.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a round to end early when defeating a final enemy under a [Sheep] debuff with an Ally Attack skill.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Head of Wrath’s [Vengeance] counter to go beyond 15 stacks when attacked with Gharol Bloodmaul’s Magma Slam skill.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Borgoth’s Easy Prey [P] skill to activate when Skavag consumes Spiderlings in the Cursed City.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Akumori the Phantom Shogun’s Shroud of the Shogun [P] skill to activate when a Champion kills themselves.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused Agreth’s Spiderlings to remain on the battlefield when killed by damage inflicted from a [Reflect Damage] buff.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Madame Serris’ Witch's Grace [P] skill to place a [Fear] debuff when an ally Champion is attacked.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash after Gharol Bloodmaul killed multiple Spiderlings under [Hex] debuffs.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Metamorph button for Mythical Champions in the Tavern to not work after increasing their Level or upgrading a skill.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused Krisk the Ageless to be stuck in a running animation after using his Centuried Vigor skill when Gnishak Verminlord is in the Leader position in the Minotaur’s Labyrinth.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Champions with the Soul Reap Blessing to activate Borgoth’s Easy Prey [P] skill when using non-attacking skills.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a battle that was finished on Auto after replaying a battle played on Manual to not count towards Progress Missions such as “Clear Stage 20 of the Spider's Den 10 times on Auto (on Normal)”.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Rathalos Blademaster’s Overhead Slash skill to attack enemies before buffs were applied.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Fatalis Blademaster’s Wide Slash skill to not ignore [Strengthen], [Increase DEF], and [Ally Protection] buffs.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused overlapping texts in the Tournaments tab.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused players to have to use both a skill that removes debuffs, and a skill that places [Block Debuffs] buffs in order to complete Dungeon Challenge 3.5. 
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a delay in the Artifact Upgrade window after successfully upgrading an Artifact.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused tabs in the Quests window to not be highlighted when switching between them in PC versions of the game.
[/list]
